According to legend, a '''noble''' of [[House Carbinol]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], at one point scuttled an ancient [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[treasure ship]]s underneath the luminescent sands of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thull's Vault]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
